## Verdict

wrong

## Bearer

MainActivity.onNewIntent — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/MainActivity.kt:147-151

## Trigger

The `PendingIntent` the complication posted on the watch face reaching `onNewIntent` on a warm resume — observed

## Today

Two entries read the same `EXTRA_TAPPED_DESTINATION` extra. The
private top-level function `tappedDestination` (MainActivity.kt:166-169),
used from `onCreate` on a cold launch, looks the name up with
`WatchDestination.entries.find { it.name == extra }` and returns
`null` on an unknown name, per its own KDoc citing R32. `onNewIntent`
(MainActivity.kt:147-151), used on a warm resume, reads the same extra
and calls `WatchDestination.valueOf(extra)` directly, which throws
`IllegalArgumentException` on a name `WatchDestination` no longer
declares. A `PendingIntent` set by a previous app version can carry
such a stale name after an update removes or renames a
`WatchDestination` constant, since it survives the update undisturbed
on the watch face.

## Expected

`onNewIntent` calls the same tolerant conversion `tappedDestination`
already performs, rather than `WatchDestination.valueOf` — an unknown
name yields `null` and the current destination is left unchanged
(`navigator.navigateTo` is simply not called), on both the cold-launch
and the warm-resume path. The conversion is written once and shared by
both entries, so a future third caller cannot reintroduce the same gap
by calling `valueOf` again.
